South Africa considers player changes for Australia Test

South Africa is considering changes to its team for the second Test against Australia following a loss in the first match. Coach Temba Bavuma has hinted at the return of Kagiso Rabada. The team may drop Tristan Stubbs and include Matthew Birtzke to strengthen the batting lineup.
